specs.Compatible Phone Models: Samsung Galaxy S21, Google Pixel 5, OnePlus 9, etc. (Android smartphones with Type-C port)

features: 3.0A USB to Type C Cable: Portronics Konnect X is a USB to Type-C Cable designed to fast charge your Android smartphone, tablets & other Type-C enabled devices.

Unbreakable & Durable: Built to last, this USB to Type-C cable has a high-quality nylon woven design with aluminum shells, preventing wear and tear over time. Its tangle-free design helps with easy storage.
Fast Charging & Data Sync: The cable supports fast charging and data transfer of videos, photos, files, etc., at 480 Mbps between your Type C devices and USB devices.
1 Meter Portable Cable: With a convenient 1-meter length, this Type C cable is perfect for use at home, in the office, in the car, during travel, and anywhere else you need it.
Warranty: The Konnect X USB to Type C cable has a warranty of 6 months against manufacturing defects.
description: Introducing the Portronics Konnect X, a robust 3.0A USB to Type-C Cable designed for swift charging of Android smartphones, tablets, and other Type-C enabled devices. Crafted for durability, its unbreakable nylon weave with aluminum shells ensures long-lasting performance, while the tangle-free design facilitates easy storage. Experience fast charging and efficient data sync at 480 Mbps. With a portable 1-meter length, this cable is your ideal companion at home, in the office, in the car, during travel, and wherever you need it. Comes with a 6-month warranty.
